1. Rumuskan satu masalah inti sebagai ko:
1. State one core problem as a negative condition, not as a missing solution.
2. Going down, ask "why does this happen?" until you reach causes that policy can address. The lowest causes are marked ROOT.
3. Going up, ask "so what happens next?" to map the effects.
4. Tag each cause with a policy aspect to see where problems cluster.
5. Open the Objective Tree to turn every negative condition into the desired one. Root causes become intervention points.

Use File > New Stunting Example to see a complete example.
